questions.q: What did Theo's Beginner project migrate for Driftwood Outdoor Apparel?
options: A Kubernetes cluster
Static assets to Azure Blob Storage and the application to a single Azure VM
The entire app to AWS
A Terraform-managed multi-region deployment
questions.explain: The Beginner project moved static product images to Blob Storage and the app itself onto one Azure VM, for IT Manager Priya Suresh.

options: Driftwood's CEO
A customer filing a support ticket
Driftwood's newly hired VP of Engineering
An AWS solutions architect
questions.explain: Casey Lindqvist is the new VP of Engineering who, along with Priya, brings Theo the bigger ask in this project.

questions.q: What are the four deliverables Priya and Casey ask for?
options: A new logo, a new CRM, a new office, a new VM
Containerize the app, add Terraform, build a CI/CD pipeline, add AWS as a backup target
Move everything to AWS, delete Azure, hire a new team, rewrite the app in a new language
A bigger VM, more RAM, a faster disk, a new monitor dashboard
questions.explain: The ask is: containerize the app, provision Azure infrastructure with Terraform, automate deploys with CI/CD, and add AWS as a backup/DR target.

questions.q: What does 'AWS as a backup target' specifically NOT mean in this project?
options: It means nothing changes at all
It means the storefront app itself migrates to and runs on AWS
It means Azure gets decommissioned
It means a second production environment in AWS, load-balanced with Azure
questions.explain: Casey scopes this deliberately: Azure stays home for the running application. AWS only holds a copy of the app's data for recovery.

questions.q: Why does Casey, as the new VP of Engineering, push for Terraform and a CI/CD pipeline rather than more hand-built infrastructure?
options: Casey dislikes the Azure portal's color scheme
Casey wants every system to be rebuildable from code and deployed automatically, not dependent on one person's memory of manual steps
Terraform is required by Driftwood's auditors
Casey wants to replace Theo
questions.explain: Casey inherited systems built one-off and wants future infrastructure and deploys to be repeatable and auditable, not tribal knowledge.
